After completing a 67-episode Game of Thrones re-watch in “Winter was Here”, Rob Cesternino and Josh Wigler preview the eighth season of Game of Thrones, which premieres this Sunday, April 14, on HBO.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 23 | Matt Hoffman
episodes.d: Matt Hoffman of Big Brother 12 joins Taran to talk about being a dad, making sure to appreciate what you have & what you’ve done, and how to figure out why people are even listening to him.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 22 | Zeke Smith
episodes.d: Zeke Smith of Survivor: Millennials vs Gen X & Game Changers joins Taran to talk about comedy, Alan Cumming, and the challenges he faced after his unique experience on Survivor.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 17 | Johnny Mac
episodes.d: Taran hangs out with the rock star dentist, Johnny Mac, from Big Brother 17. They talk dentistry, music, cultural expectations, college, and being a weirdo.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 16 | Nick Iadanza
episodes.d: Taran talks with Australian Survivor & Podcaster Nick Iadanza about Australia, mateship, and the tragic struggle of losing a parent.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 15 | Brent Wolgamott Part II
episodes.d: The long-awaited Brent Part II has arrived. Taran talks to Brent Wolgamott about his addiction, his sexuality, and the miracle that he says saved his life.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 14 | Dom Harvey Interview
episodes.d: Taran battles Dom Harvey from the Dom & Colin podcast for control of the show as Dom turns the lens onto Taran himself. They discuss their mutual introversion, the “I got screwed by a twist” origins of Dom & Colin, depression, remakes, and more.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 13 | Cameron Heard Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with the first one out from Big Brother 19, Cameron Heard! Taran chastises Cam for losing him the LFC draft, they discuss the dangers of live recording, and Cameron talks through his very short-lived Big Brother 19 experience.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 12 | Josh Wigler Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with his new best friend Josh Wigler about their mutual love of TV, G.I. Joes, and Survivor. Josh also chronicles his journalistic journey and they discuss their recent project, First One Out.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 11 | Matt Iseman Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks to the host of American Ninja Warrior about his Celebrity Apprentice win, his Big Brother fandom, how he made the transition from doctor to comedian, and plenty more!

episodes.t: The Taran Show 10 | Lita Brillman Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks to his American Ninja Warrior co-host Lita about the origins of her political views, her love of reality TV, and how she is finding the strength to face what she’s endured.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 9 | Neda Kalantar Interview
episodes.d:
Content Warning: Some adult language is used in this interview.  
 The long-awaited Neda interview has finally arrived! Taran talks to Neda about her experience growing up in Iran, how she’s handled the anxiety that comes with the spotlight of Big Brother, and her immense love of cats.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 8 | Aubry Bracco Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with two time Survivor player Aubry Bracco about her love of storytelling, the challenges she faced after playing Survivor, and how she handles being part of one of the more controversial endings to a Survivor season in recent memory.

episodes.t: The Taran Show 7 | Melissa Deni Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with Live Feed Correspondent and Lawyer, Melissa Deni about her path to becoming a lawyer, the importance of her family, and how to decide when it’s time to give up on your passion.They also chronicle the infamous “So You Think You Can Podcast” competition and how sh

episodes.t: The Taran Show 6 | Eric Stein Interview
episodes.d: Eric Stein regales Taran with his many tales of his time in the TV industry, expresses his frustration for his Big Brother experience, and pinpoints the defining quality that has allowed him to succeed in his own unconventional way.

episodes.t: The Taran Show | Jordan Parhar Interview
episodes.d: Taran speaks with his old friend Jordan Parhar about his retirement from reality TV podcasting, how major surgeries helped shape his life, and how his supportive family has always been his true source of strength.

episodes.t: The Taran Show | Audrey Middleton Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with Big Brother 17 contestant and creator of Sequester, Audrey Middleton about her take on the offensive comments made about her on Big Brother 19, their mutual love of games, and her plans to expand Sequester into the real world.

episodes.t: The Taran Show | Ian Terry Interview
episodes.d: Taran talks with the youngest Big Brother winner, Ian Terry from season 14. Ian talks about what drew him to Big Brother, his experience going on the show, and how he handled coming out of the house with 500 thousand dollars and all kinds of attention.

episodes.t: The Taran Show | Brent Wolgamott Interview
episodes.d:
Taran talks with Brent Wolgamott, one of the Live Feed Correspondents for Rob Has A Podcast, about his involvement as the star witness in the Michael Peterson trial, and how his life as an escort brought him to that moment.
